**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear description of what the problem is (e.g. "I'm always frustrated
when...").

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've thought about.

**Additional context**
Anything else — mockups, similar features in other apps, etc.

**Would this require any proprietary dependencies?**
- [ ] No — this keeps AudioBridge fully FOSS
- [ ] Not sure
- [ ] Yes (note: features requiring proprietary SDKs/trackers won't be
      accepted — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md))
